title: Engine unit-level control: unit list/reset, run --only, self-heal, guarded new, per-unit dry run (REQ-0113)
requirement: REQ-0113. User 2026-10-26: fix one failed unit by selecting or resetting that unit only; never re-run a whole phase and hope the cache covers it; make the engine more stable and faster for real reviews. Design: docs/design/phase-146-pipeline-unit-control.md. No dependency on TASK-144 or the Vietnamworks review (user, RAW-01062: order only, no relationship); go given by RAW-01061. Replaces the interim pipeline_step.sh.
acceptance_criteria: AC1 a failed/held/reset unit re-runs alone (1 call), other done units untouched
AC2 wiped unit table with valid outputs: 0 calls on resume
AC3 new cannot wipe a running run with done units by accident
AC4 --only dry-run lists units, no-flag dry-run unchanged
AC6 reset unit really called; old output kept until success; gaps=0

design.summary: Per-unit control of pipeline.sh: unit list/reset with a fresh_call flag that bypasses every reuse path, run --only, same-run self-heal, guarded new (--yes-wipe), --only dry-run, status --units + stale line; retire pipeline_step.sh. 146.7 dropped. Slices A/B/C.
risks: reset unit re-marked done by reuse (fresh_call)
reopened run re-runs post-run hooks (track idempotency)

implementation.summary: Slices A (5b3584dc: fresh_call, unit list/reset, run --only, self-heal), B (63d06698: guarded new --yes-wipe, --only dry-run, status --units + stale line), C (pipeline_step.sh retired, guide + run-pipeline skill, goldens G1-G3 PASS).

unit_test.command: tests/run_all.sh --fast; tests/run_all.sh pipeline_unit_control + 10 pipeline suites; .claude/scripts/checks/shell.sh; G1-G3
unit_test.result: run_all --fast 171 suites 0 failed (30 skipped); pipeline_unit_control 48/0; 10 pipeline suites 0 fail; shell.sh 593 pass; bites a-d fail on their path (5/1/2/9); G1,G3 reproduce; G2 PASS with hash masked (gold.sh does not mask hash). security.result: jq inputs via --arg; keys checked against the unit table before forming paths; writes after acquire_lock; --yes-wipe reason one line 10+ chars; secrets.sh 0 hits in changed files. Low F-146-1: unquoted glob in the two key loops (pipeline.sh:1791,1918) can only cause a false refusal; follow-up set -f.
